feat(tracker): define case-insensitive Issue references

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-21
  description: |-
    IssueId remains the only semantic identity for equivalent prefix and legacy-key forms.
    
    Callers need one transport-neutral contract that accepts mixed-case prefix input, stores and emits uppercase prefixes, and parses hyphenated Workspace keys without guessing identity from raw strings.
